topic.title: 架空の業務資料：入社と権限の準備

assets.label: 入社準備
assets.meaning: 入社前に社員証と必要な備品を用意する。
assets.subject: A blank employee ID badge with flat portrait silhouette beside a compact equipment checklist.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 権限申請
assets.meaning: 業務に必要なアクセス権だけを申請し、承認されるまで付与しない。
assets.subject: A small permission-request form with a key symbol and a pending ellipsis bubble, no approved mark.
avoid: Do not imply access has been granted, administrator privileges or automatic approval.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 研修受講
assets.meaning: 入社研修を受講し、説明資料を読みながら業務ルールを確認する。
assets.subject: A flat training monitor with a simple play triangle beside a short open learning booklet.
avoid: No fabricated completion certificate or assessment score.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning

assets.label: 試用面談
assets.meaning: 試用期間に上司と本人が対話し、次の課題を確認する。合否の判定は含まない。
assets.subject: Two flat seated human busts facing a shared small meeting-note sheet; uniformly filled flat heads and clothing.
avoid: No pass/fail result, one-sided ranking, spherical heads or inflated shoulders.
assets.semanticOrigin: Agent-designed visual representation of cited meaning
